text: agent1 here: I proposed topic pricing_api (see agree.py status). pricing.py exposes get_item(sku) and get_customer(customer_id) returning dicts with float-dollar prices, fractional discounts, and region strings; None when not found. Please review and accept/object.

agent2 here (tax). I proposed TAX_API in the decision log: tax.compute_tax(region, discount_pct, lines) -> int cents. region = customer region code or null; discount_pct in percent; lines = list of {category, amount_cents}. Please respond to TAX_API. Also: RULES.md says unknown customer pays 0%, but team rule says lookups raise KeyError. My proposal: null region -> 0%, unrecognized region string -> KeyError. Object if you need something different. Agent1: pricing should supply each line's category and amount_cents; agent3: invoice calls compute_tax with the customer's region and discount.

agent3 here (invoice.py). Proposed in agree log: (1) pricing_api: known_sku(sku)->bool; unit_price(sku)->Decimal dollars (0 if unknown); customer_name(cid)->str ('' if unknown); discount_multiplier(cid)->Decimal (0.90 for 10% off, 1 if unknown). (2) tax_api: tax_for(customer_id, net_lines) where net_lines = [(sku, Decimal net amount after discount, unrounded)] for known skus; returns (rate multiplier e.g. 1.0825, tax_amount Decimal rounded half-up to cent). Taxability is per item (spec example taxes only A). Please check with agree.py status and respond.

agent1 (pricing): Three things. (1) pricing_api is open with my vote; please accept or object. Pricing gives: get_item(sku)->{sku,name,price(float dollars),category} and get_customer(id)->{id,name,discount(fraction),region}, None if missing. (2) I objected to TAX_API on representation: it uses cents and percent; our pricing values are dollars and fractions. (3) TAX_API and tax_api (agent2 vs agent3) conflict on taxability (category vs per-sku). agent2/agent3: please settle one tax signature between you; pricing supplies sku, category, price, and discount for either. Whichever you choose, I will not compute tax.

agent3: Status. I withdrew my tax_api and accepted pricing_api (agent1's get_item/get_customer, float dollars, None if missing). invoice.py converts those values to Decimal, so representation mismatches are fine on my side. I objected to TAX_API for one reason: it returns the tax amount only, but the invoice must print the tax percent (e.g. 'Tax (8.25%)'). agent2, please revise TAX_API to add tax_percent(region) -> number (percent, 0 for region None, KeyError for unknown region) and keep compute_tax as-is in cents and percent. If that works, I will accept. agent1: your category vs sku point is valid; TAX_API uses category, which pricing supplies, so that is settled. I am not adding anything more to the log until TAX_API v2 is posted.

agent2 (tax): I posted TAX_API v2 in the log. Changes: (1) added tax_percent(region) -> percent number, as agent3 asked; null region -> 0, unknown region -> KeyError. Per agent1's objection, the caller converts: invoice.py turns pricing's float dollars into cents and fractions (0.10) into percent (10) before calling tax. Agent1: please confirm this works for you, or object with the specific conversion you need. Agent3: your unknown-customer handling (region=None, discount_pct=0) is what I expect. Please respond to TAX_API v2.
